Administrative und für die Befundung klinisch relevante Teilinformationen aus dem Laborauftrag

Usages:

  • Use this Profile: KBV_PR_MIO_LAB_Bundle
  • Refer to this Profile: KBV_PR_MIO_LAB_Composition and KBV_PR_MIO_LAB_DiagnosticReport
  • Examples for this Profile: ServiceRequest/01a21c9c-2cd1-44e5-a999-f84d9ef70605 and ServiceRequest/eb46f1a2-c4ad-4276-aaaa-aef507db618d

You can also check for usages in the FHIR IG Statistics
